resources.string: Enable Nothing Tweaks in LSPosed, select the apps in scope, then reboot.
Allow the screen to rotate completely upside-down.
Show options to reboot into Recovery and Bootloader in the power menu.
Do not require credentials to power off from the lock screen.
Disable the sponsored magazine wallpaper on the lock screen.
Randomize the position of the PIN pad numbers.
Hide the clock from the lockscreen. Useful while using third-party apps for depth effect wallpapers.
Display real-time wattage, current, voltage, and temperature while charging on the lockscreen.
Double tap an empty area on the lockscreen to turn off the screen.
Double tap the screen to wake the device.\n\nNOTE: You must enable \"Tap to show lock screen\" in phone Settings → Lock screen for this to work.
Hide Nav Bar (with Circle to Search)

Makes the gesture pill invisible but keeps it fully functional for gestures and Circle to Search.\n\nNOTE: You MUST enable the navigation bar in your system settings first, and also ensure Circle to Search is enabled in your system settings, then turn this on to hide the pill!
Removes empty space under the keyboard and hides the navigation handle while typing
Long Swipe Back to Kill App
Hold the back swipe gesture then release to force-stop the foreground app.
Shows the Nothing earbud icon instead of the generic Bluetooth icon whenever any audio device is connected.
Maximum number of notification icons to show in the status bar and AOD. Leave blank for default.
Reduces the empty space at the left and right edges of the status bar.
Slide horizontally across the status bar to adjust screen brightness.
Prepends the short weekday, e.g. Mon 10:10.
Appended custom text after the time. Leave blank for none. Max 24 chars.
Milliseconds before the volume panel hides. Leave blank for stock (3000 ms).
Off by default. Turning it on draws "SN:" + your device serial onto every screenshot.
Forces a resolution or frame-rate clamp in ScreenMediaRecorder. Off leaves stock behaviour untouched.
Recolours the animated dots that appear around your finger while the sensor reads it.
A fresh colour each time you touch the sensor. Turn this off to choose your own colour below.
Turn off the screen by covering it with your palm. Only works at lock screen.
Flip the phone to start voice recording. Hold the essential key to start recording.
Forces the ChatGPT clipboard AI feature to work with Gemini.
Disables the high-temperature warning popups from the system.
